We Love Giving

Rising Star Scholarship

MBV Charleston’s Sprinting Forward, Giving Back campaign is proud of our Rising Star Scholarship program, providing valuable opportunities for our local high school students to continue their education and pursue their passions.

Apply Now
$ 10000

Value of scholarships awarded to South Carolina students since 2018

Where?

MBV Charleston launched the program in 2023 to support high school seniors located in the Tri-County area (Charleston, Dorchester, and Berkeley) and high school seniors who are dependent children of MBV Charleston Team Members who plan to attend college or vocational school. Scholarships are offered each year for full-time study at an accredited institution of the student’s choice.

How much and how many?

If selected as a recipient, the student will receive a one-time scholarship valued at $5,000. Up to 18 awards, for a total of $90,000 will be granted each year, with ten scholarships being granted to dependent children of MBV Charleston Team Members, four scholarships being granted to students from high schools in the selected areas, and four being granted to students from high schools in the selected areas planning to attend Trident Technical College.

Who?

This scholarship program is administered by Scholarship Management Services, a department of Scholarship America. Scholarship America is a national nonprofit educational support and student aid service organization that seeks to involve and assist the private sector in expanding educational opportunities and encouraging educational achievement. Awards are granted without regard to race, color, creed, religion, gender, disability, or national origin.

Who We Are

Welcome to Mercedes-Benz Vans Charleston

Mercedes-Benz Vans, LLC (MBV Charleston) is the only Mercedes-Benz Vans production facility in the United States. Since 2006, the Ladson-based facility has assembled Metris, Sprinter, and eSprinter vans for delivery to destinations across the U.S. and Canada — making it the second largest market for Sprinter vans after Germany.

In 2018, MBV Charleston made a substantial investment in expanding the production facility. This expansion included the addition of a Body Shop, a Paint Shop, and an extension to the existing Assembly Shop — enabling full part-by-part assembly of Metris and Sprinter vans.

Subsequently, MBV Charleston was selected as the first plant in the Mercedes-Benz Vans global production network to produce the all-new eSprinter van — representing a significant additional investment. Production of the eSprinter began in early 2024, and shortly after, the MBV Charleston team celebrated key milestones in its rollout.

Today, MBV Charleston employs a dedicated team and supports numerous on-site roles through its suppliers, contributing to a broad economic impact across the region.

Mercedes-Benz Vans Charleston also continues to invest in the local community, with substantial donations to local non-profits and schools through STEM programs and ongoing volunteer efforts.

Video

Our History

With the success of the Sprinter van in the U.S. market, the decision was made to expand the current re-assembly operation to a full-scale production plant for the Sprinter van, which opened in 2018. In addition to our current operation, the Mercedes-Benz group has had a presence in North Charleston for longer than you might think, starting with the assembly of Western Star trucks in 1999.

Careers

Together for excellence.

Becoming part of Mercedes-Benz means more than discovering new working fields and exciting challenges. Joining this world evolving around the most desirable cars and vans means entering an inspiring workspace that empowers you to find your role and unleash your talents to the fullest.  

At Mercedes-Benz Vans Charleston, we offer you the perfect environment for your professional and personal growth. Cutting-edge training and promising career opportunities will help you to foster and expand your professional skill set as well as your strengths.

Join Us
Sign Up for Job Alerts
Sign Up for Job Alerts

Jobs & Careers

Students

Our extensive internship programs make us one of the best companies in the country to start your career. We offer paid internships across nearly all departments, including Engineering, IT, Human Resources, Production, Finance and More! Whether you are a recent graduate or a local or international student interested in an internship, Mercedes-Benz Vans is the right place to embark upon your career path.  

We offer many opportunities for students to develop the skills necessary for success.

Apply Now

Professionals

At Mercedes-Benz Vans, we offer you the perfect environment for your professional and personal growth. Cutting-edge training and promising career opportunities will help you to foster and expand your professional skill set as well as your individual strengths. Think, try, and thrive with us in collaborative work environments that spark game-changing concepts.

 MBV offers entry level to experienced professionals positions.

Apply Now

Production

Individuals looking to work in an exciting production environment can find opportunities in different areas such as Assembly, Body shop, and Paint shop. Mercedes Benz Vans can hand you the keys for an exciting career in the automotive manufacturing industry. Mercedes-Benz vans are world-renowned for quality and innovation. Start a new chapter in your career with MBV.

MBV has partnered with The Ōnin Group to support our hiring process. This is a contingent workforce/ temporary position which leads to full-time positions.

Apply Now

Maintenance & Skilled Trades

Experienced individuals looking to work in maintenance or specialized technical functions can bring their specialized knowledge here and find exciting opportunities. Work with cutting-edge technologies. Perform troubleshooting and repair of vehicles (e.g. Paint and Body) and equipment (e.g. electrical and robotic systems). 

If you are interested in joining the MBV family, we welcome you to apply.

Apply Now

Testimonials

“I would say that the thing I’m most proud of is the brand because when people talk about Mercedes they know what that means: high quality. It’s Mercedes-Benz.”

Mario Trammell
Paint Shop

“My most favorite part of my job is that every day is different. I never feel stuck or tired of the work that I’m doing, and I really like to get a sneak peek at the future projects as well.”

Abby Tootle
EVS Prototype Engineer

Our Philosophy

MBV Charleston aims to support you and your loved ones through life’s various stages. We offer competitive and unique compensation and benefits programs designed to meet the needs of our diverse population.

Some of our benefits include health insurance, 401(k) retirement matching plan, vacation, holidays, floating holidays, disability coverage, discount programs, employee lease car program, shift premium, new parent leave, workplace flexibility programs, and life insurance. 

We are committed to excellence and actively promote teamwork, safety, quality, and continuous improvement every day. Investing in lifelong learning and offering opportunities for personal and professional development is essential to us. We also offer a full-service cafeteria, a gift store, and a coffee bar. 

Eager to drive a Mercedes? At MBV, you can take advantage of our rewarding employee lease program.

Equal Opportunity

Mercedes-Benz Vans is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We Love Giving

Sprinting Forward, Giving Back

Mercedes-Benz Vans Charleston is committed to supporting our community through our corporate social responsibility initiative: Sprinting Forward, Giving Back. Our strategy is firmly anchored in the company’s goal to positively impact future generations and make a difference across the Lowcountry, in communities where we work and live.

Rising Star Scholarships

Providing valuable opportunities for our local high school students by offering 18 $5,000 scholarships for them to continue their education.

Learn More

At Mercedes-Benz Charleston, we are active in our communities and support programs that align with our values of education, sustainability, and social responsibility.

STEM Education

Mercedes-Benz is the product of innovation, and innovation is only possible with a foundation of education. We support STEM programs in local schools and provide scholarships for local high school students to continue their education. We also create opportunities for students to increase their awareness and stewardship of the environment. At Mercedes-Benz Vans Charleston, we want children to have the knowledge and desire to improve the world. MBV Charleston is committed to supporting STEM education programs that empower the next generation. We want to help expose students to new aspects of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics, providing them with relevant and real-world knowledge to prepare them for successful careers.

Charleston Promise Neighborhood

Charleston County School District

Dorchester School District Two

Sustainability

Our Charleston plant has several environmental initiatives, including Paperless Factory and Zero Waste to Landfill. Our goal is to minimize waste while still delivering a top-quality product. Beyond our plant’s doors, we work to restore the oyster reef and support sea turtle rescue and rehabilitation. These local environmental efforts allow us to keep the Lowcountry beautiful and sustainable for everyone. MBV Charleston is deeply rooted in the Charleston community. From the very beginning, we have made the sustainable treatment of the environment a priority. We strive to create a positive contribution for our community and future generations by supporting efforts that champion sustainability.

Berkeley County Kids Who Care About Our Environment

South Carolina Aquarium

Social Responsibility

Mercedes-Benz Vans Charleston has volunteered countless hours and donated millions of dollars to important causes throughout the Lowcountry, from food banks to backpacks for back-to-school. MBV Privacy Statement

Effective April 10, 2023

This Privacy Statement explains the privacy practices of Mercedes-Benz Vans, LLC (“MBV”), including the information MBV collects about you, how that information is used or shared, how we protect your information and your rights and choices with regard to such information. This Privacy Statement applies to personal information collected by or on behalf of MBV (“we,” “us”), including information collected through MBV’s websites and mobile versions of our websites (collectively, the “Sites”), at our facility locations or events, email, phone or anywhere else we display this Privacy Statement (collectively referred to in this Privacy Statement as the “MBV Platform”).  The MBV Platform may include links to other websites or tools owned and operated by corporate affiliates of MBV that are not subject to this Privacy Statement.

MBV is located in the United States and the MBV Platform is hosted in the United States and is targeted to individuals in the United States. If you access the MBV Platform from other regions, be aware that the privacy practices of MBV may differ from those of the country where you are located. By interacting with the MBV Platform, you are accepting the terms of this Privacy Statement. If you do not accept the terms of this Privacy Statement, do not use the MBV Platform.

Information We Collect and How We Collect It

Personal information is information that directly or indirectly identifies you or can be used to identify you as an individual. When you interact with the MBV Platform we collect information: 1) that you provide to us directly; and 2) that we collect passively based on your interaction with the Site and other tools within the MBV Platform as further described below.

Information You Provide to Us

Some features of the MBV Platform ask you to provide us with specific categories of information to enjoy complete functionality. If you do not provide us with the categories of information requested, your ability to fully interact with the MBV Platform may be limited. The general categories of information we ask you to provide and the purposes for our collection of such information include:

Inquiries

To submit inquiries through the MBV Platform, you must provide certain information. This information is required so that you can be contacted about your request. Some MBV Platform forms also require you to provide us with your geographic region or zip code so that we can direct your request appropriately or customize the information you requested. We may also collect certain personal information if you contact us by phone or email, so that we can best address your request or question. We use information such as your name and contact details to communicate with you and to provide requested information or services.

Testimonials

You may choose to provide a testimonial, photograph, quote, or other video image or personal information associated with a testimonial which we may then post on the MBV Platform where it can be accessed or viewed by other users.

News and Promotions

If you choose to subscribe to receive our latest news, special offers and exclusives, we will collect your email address.

Other Interactions

We may also collect your personal information in person at events or during virtual events, including your name, contact information and photos or videos of your image depending on the manner you choose to engage with us or participate in such events.

Information We Collect Automatically

Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and other tracking technologies to personalize your experience, analyze user trends, and improve the Site. These tracking technologies allow us to collect information such as your device type, browser type, time spent on the Site, pages visited, geographic region, and other data.

Do Not Track

The MBV Platform does not respond to “Do Not Track” signals at this time.

Third Parties

We also obtain information about the traffic and usage of the Site from third-party service providers, including Google, Kenshoo, and Shift Digital. These third parties also use cookies and other tracking technologies to capture information about your interactions with the Sites in addition to information about sites you have visited. These providers may place and access cookies, pixel tags, or similar technologies on your device to serve you ads or other content personalized to your interests, which they infer from your browsing on the Site and other sites you have visited. MBV does not have control over the information that is collected, used, and shared by these third parties. We encourage you to review the privacy statements of these third parties to understand their privacy practices.

Your Choices

Opting Out of Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies

You can alter the configuration of your browser to refuse to accept cookies, but it is possible that doing so may cause limited functionality of the Site. Note also that MBV does not control third parties’ collection or use of your information to serve interest-based advertising. However, these third parties may provide you with ways to choose not to have your information collected or used in this way. You can opt out of receiving targeted ads from members of the Network Advertising Initiative (“NAI”) on the NAI’s website.

Communication Preferences

To contact us with a question, use the methods listed in the Contact Us section at the bottom of this Privacy Statement.

Information Uses

We use your personal information to accomplish our business and commercial purposes, including for transactional and marketing purposes or to otherwise improve our products and services. For example, we may use your information to:

  • Response to your questions or requests or otherwise communicate with you.
  • Customize the information we provide to you based on your general location and interests.
  • Protect the security of MBV Platforms and improve our products and services
  • Conduct analysis related to our Platforms and products
  • Comply with legal procedures, requirements, regulations and statutes
  • Assist law enforcement and respond to legal or regulatory requests and protect the legal rights, health or safety of you or others

Information Sharing

MBV Affiliates

We may sometimes share your information with MBV affiliates and parent companies for business operations and to send you information about products or services we think may be of interest to you.

Service Providers

We may share your information with service providers that help us operate the MBV Platform and other business activities on our behalf.

Other
Aside from the instances described above, we will only share your personal information: to comply with the law; to respond to claims; to comply with legal process served on MBV or our parent company Mercedes-Benz AG (e.g., a lawful subpoena, warrant, or court order); to enforce or apply our policies or agreements; (including to bill and collect payments); to protect and defend our rights or property or that of our dealers, customers, employees, visitors, or the public; in connection with a business transfer, sale, liquidation, or merger; and if we reasonably believe that an emergency involving immediate danger of death or serious physical injury to any person requires disclosure; with your consent.

Third-Party Platforms

The MBV Platform contains links to other websites such as social media platforms, other Mercedes-Benz websites, and event and partner websites. These websites are not covered by this Privacy Statement and we do not control the privacy practices of such third-party platforms. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of such third-party platforms for more information regarding their information practices.

California Residents

Pursuant to California Civil Code § 1798.83, California residents with whom we have a business relationship can request information about the types of personal information, if any, we shared with third parties for the direct marketing purposes of the third parties and the identities of the third parties with whom we shared such information in the last 12 months. We do not share your personal information with third parties in this manner and have not done so in the last 12 months. You may request more information by contacting us using the Contact Us information at the bottom of this Privacy Statement.

Children's Privacy

The MBV Platform is neither designed for nor targeted to children under the age of 13. If you are under the age of 13, do not provide your personal information through the MBV Platform. If you believe your child has impermissibly provided us with their personal information, please contact us, so that we can identify and delete their information.

Security and Retention

We use commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect personal information collected through the MBV Platform. We retain the information we collect for as long as reasonably necessary to provide services and fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Statement.

Updates

MBV may update or change this Privacy Statement from time to time and without prior notice to you. The top of this Privacy Statement will indicate when it was most recently updated. Where changes to our privacy practices are material, we will notify you in accordance with applicable law.

Contact Us

If you have comments, questions, or concerns about this Privacy Statement or about MBV’s collection, use, or disclosure of your personal information, please contact us using one of the following methods:
